decisions.reason: The glass flake spraying system extends WIWA's core two-component coating business into a specialised corrosion-protection niche, its website presence is stable, and there is no shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search.
The injection pump has its own page and a documented field use after a test phase, so it meets aspirations and builds on the firm's established pump know-how.
The transfer pump reuses proven WIWA air motors, so it costs little to carry, and the firm's slack lets it stay on the market while results develop.
Flow monitoring is further from the core spraying business, but it is still featured on its own page and is cheap to maintain, so there is no clear performance gap that would justify dropping it.
The hydraulic two-component spraying system was launched only in 2024 and fits squarely in the core product line, so its results are too early to judge against aspirations.
